title: 12-name watchlist · 07 Nov 2026 (Sat) · 08:00 SGT
summary: All 12 prices now reflect the completed November 6 US session, with 72 freshly checked adjusted-close baselines. Google acquires a Wyoming data-center site and a Google executive leaves the SpaceX board. Apple’s final bond prospectus resolves an earlier terms gap; Tesla files annual-meeting materials. NVIDIA and Meta ownership transfers are distinguished from market sales. A TSMC advanced-memory report is added as a qualified late-observed correction.
coverage_note: Fixed cutoff: 7 November 08:00 SGT (00:00 UTC). Incremental window: 7 November 03:30–08:00 SGT, covering the previous 04:00 SGT edition with a 30-minute overlap. TSMC’s 6 November 23:45:40 SGT Reuters article predates the window and is explicitly a late-observed correction. Eleven accessible SEC feeds were checked; four original in-window filings were read. Amazon’s previously unavailable SEC feed was not retried. Reuters and issuer access is partial, and a quiet-name result does not mean no news occurred. Prior editions remain unchanged.
price_basis: USD regular-session closes for 6 Nov 2026, the latest completed US session at cutoff. Fresh Yahoo Finance daily series and regularMarketTime metadata retrieved 7 Nov 00:06:42–00:06:51 UTC verify all 12 closes. The exact vendor quote timestamps are 6 Nov 21:00:00–21:00:02 UTC for eleven names and 21:03:23 UTC for BRK.B; each quoted price matches the completed daily bar. Daily changes compare Nov 6 with Nov 5 ordinary closes. Adjusted closes are separate cumulative-return endpoints. Daily-bar timestamps are session labels, not substituted quote timestamps. Postmarket observations are excluded. TSM is the US-listed USD ADR. These saved observations are not live.
return_basis: Six cumulative 1–6 month returns use Yahoo adjusted closes reflecting vendor split and dividend/distribution adjustments. Formula: (endpoint adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1) x 100. Source values are rounded to cents before independent Decimal arithmetic; percentages round to two decimals. Baselines are the latest available sessions on or before each monthly anniversary: 6 Oct, 4 Sep, 6 Aug, 6 Jul, 5 Jun and 6 May 2026. Returns are not annualised and exclude investor fees, tax and FX. No independent reconstruction of dividend-adjustment factors or reinvestment model is claimed.
caveats: Reuters access is partial. Included narrow article facts and publication timestamps were retrieved through search; original company/SEC evidence is identified separately. Search silence does not establish absence of news.

Amazon SEC and Micron IR prior HTTP 403 responses were respected without retry. Alphabet IR direct access remains unavailable; Crusoe’s release text was retrieved through search rather than a successful direct page open.

The $17 billion Wyoming figure is prior announced project investment, not a disclosed purchase price. TSMC’s advanced-memory consideration is Reuters reporting attributed to The Information, not issuer confirmation.
Apple’s final prospectus is a substantive update to the same previously reported financing, not a second deal; expected November 9 settlement has not been verified as completed.

NVIDIA’s gift and Meta’s estate-planning transfer are ownership disclosures, not verified open-market sales or indications of the user’s holdings. Tesla’s requested votes are board views, not research recommendations.

Price and baseline checks use one vendor, Yahoo Finance, without independent cross-vendor corroboration. Vendor adjustment factors are not independently reconstructed. Cents-first arithmetic is reproducible from displayed inputs and can differ slightly from unrounded calculations.

research.headline: Apple files final terms for the previously reported $7.5 billion bond offering
facts: The prospectus supplement dated November 5 was accepted by the SEC on November 6 at 21:30:47 UTC. It confirms seven tranches totalling $7.5 billion, rather than a second financing transaction.

Five fixed-rate tranches carry coupons from 4.650% to 5.350%, maturing in 2028, 2029, 2031, 2033 and 2036. Two floating-rate tranches mature in 2028 and 2029 at compounded SOFR plus 0.33% and 0.45%, respectively.
Underwriters expect delivery on or about November 9. This is a scheduled settlement, not confirmation that the transaction has closed.
research.analysis: The original issuer document resolves the earlier edition’s final-terms gap and clarifies the blend of fixed and floating borrowing costs. Coupon rates are not yields to maturity.
research.risks: Settlement remains prospective at the cutoff. Floating-rate costs vary with SOFR; issuance alone does not establish a change in operating performance.
research.next_watch: Closing confirmation and subsequent debt disclosures.

research.headline: NVIDIA director’s disclosure records a gift, not a market sale
facts: Tench Coxe reported a November 4 gift of 500,000 shares for no consideration, with transaction code G. The Form 4 was accepted November 6 at 21:12:02 UTC.
The filing references a Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted March 19, 2026, and states that the shares were held by a trust.
research.analysis: This is an ownership disclosure, not a company operating update or evidence of shares being sold in the market.
research.risks: A gift does not establish a bearish investment view; do not read the zero consideration as the market price.
research.next_watch: Subsequent ownership filings, keeping gifts and market transactions distinct.

research.headline: Google executive Donald Harrison leaves SpaceX board
facts: Reuters reports Google executive Donald Harrison left the SpaceX board after more than a decade. The original SEC filing’s text states that he notified SpaceX on November 4, effective immediately.
SpaceX says the decision was not due to disagreement regarding its operations, policies or practices. This is the issuer’s statement.
research.analysis: A governance change involving a Google executive; it does not establish any change in Alphabet’s economic exposure.
research.risks: The statement does not establish the full personal rationale or any Alphabet stake sale, financial impact or Tesla transaction.
research.next_watch: Further company disclosure of governance or investment changes.

research.next_watch: Further ownership disclosures rather than inferring an investment signal from this transfer.
